author: CalcHub
content:
Some tools you use once a year; others you reach for weekly. These ten cover the decisions most people actually face — money, health, time and everyday maths — and every one of them is free, with no sign-up.

## 1. Mortgage Calculator

Before you make an offer on a house, know the monthly payment. Try a few rates and terms: the difference between 6% and 7% over 30 years is thousands a year. Start with the [Mortgage Calculator](/mortgage-calculator).

## 2. BMI Calculator

Body mass index is a quick screening measure, not a diagnosis — but it is the number doctors ask about first. The [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator) also shows the healthy weight range for your height.

## 3. Percentage Calculator

Discounts, tips, tax, pay rises — percentages hide in almost every money decision. The [Percentage Calculator](/percentage-calculator) handles percent-of, percent change and ratios in one place.

## 4. Age Calculator

Exact age in years, months and days, plus the total days lived. Useful for forms, anniversaries and the occasional argument about who is older. Try the [Age Calculator](/age-calculator).

## 5. Compound Interest Calculator

The single most motivating number in personal finance: what your savings become if you start now. The [Compound Interest Calculator](/compound-interest-calculator) shows how time beats amount.

## 6. Loan Calculator

Car, personal loan or anything with a fixed rate — see the monthly payment and the true total cost before you sign. Use the [Loan Calculator](/loan-calculator).

## 7. TDEE Calculator

Your total daily energy expenditure is the starting point for any calorie target, whether you want to maintain, lose or gain weight. Find yours with the [TDEE Calculator](/tdee-calculator).

## 8. Days Between Dates Calculator

Project deadlines, notice periods, countdowns to a trip — counting days by hand is error-prone, especially across leap years. The [Days Between Dates Calculator](/days-between-dates-calculator) does it instantly.

## 9. GPA Calculator

Students: know where you stand before the semester ends, and work out what grades you need to hit your target. See the [GPA Calculator](/gpa-calculator).

## 10. Word Counter

Writers, students and anyone with a word limit — words, characters, sentences and reading time in one paste. Open the [Word Counter](/word-counter).

## Why bookmark them?

All ten run entirely in your browser. Nothing you type is uploaded, saved or tracked, so you can check a salary figure, a health number or a loan offer without wondering where the data went. Browse the full set in the [tool directory](/tools).

title: 10 free calculators everyone should bookmark
